units.source_text: “我心情不快，他们偏偏殷勤劝酒，多喝了真难过！

en.t: I am not feeling well, yet they kept pressing wine on me so attentively; drinking too much has made me feel truly miserable!

units.source_text: 既然有缘来到此地，让我在这里躲一下吧。”

en.t: Since fate has brought me here, let me hide here for a little while.”

units.source_text: 他说着，便掀起门帘，把上半身躲进帘子里来。

en.t: As he said this, he lifted the curtain and slipped the upper half of his body inside behind it.

units.source_text: 但听见有一个女子说：“咦！这话真可笑！

en.t: Then he heard a woman say, “Oh! What a ridiculous thing to say!

units.source_text: 下贱的人才攀缘，像你这样高贵的身份，何必说‘有缘’呢？”

en.t: Only lowly people cling to connections; with a noble status like yours, why speak of ‘fate’ at all?”

units.source_text: 一看，这个人模样虽不十分庄重，但也并非普通青年侍女，分明具有高贵的美质。

en.t: Looking at her, he saw that although her appearance was not especially dignified, she was no ordinary young lady-in-waiting, and clearly possessed a noble beauty.
